The room was quiet enough for the guest of honor to speak without a microphone. I let a little time go by before collecting the envelopes, then checked each name against our contributions list.
labelBoundaryObjections.causalReason: The passage explicitly establishes a toast and a speaker. The delay before collecting envelopes can preserve that speaking opportunity, an implicit social function protected by the definition.
labelBoundaryObjections.effectOnDiffInterpretation: The recorded new catch is arithmetically correct under the current label. On the preferred reading, the flip introduces a false positive.
labelBoundaryObjections.proposedOperation: Adjudicate whether this specific toast/speech sequence supports postponing collection under the frozen implicit-function rule; preserve source wording and saved inference.

labelBoundaryObjections.text: Dad held the tablet sideways, trying to line up the tiny charging socket. His hands shook, and the plug kept striking its rim. I lingered for a moment, then took the cable from him. With the television unplugged, the lounge was quiet enough for us to hear the charging chime. We left the tablet flat on the table and used the longer cable so he could watch it from his chair.
labelBoundaryObjections.causalReason: The father is already trying to connect the cable. Delayed intervention gives his ongoing attempt time before the narrator takes over; the pause has a particular relationship to that task.
labelBoundaryObjections.effectOnDiffInterpretation: The recorded lost catch is arithmetically correct under the current label. On the preferred reading, the flip corrects a false positive.
labelBoundaryObjections.proposedOperation: Adjudicate the interval as an opportunity for the father's ongoing attempt under the frozen definition. Preserve the wording and distinguish task-related restraint from a generic emotional reaction.
